name: Cagara SQL
comment: The compiled SQL the extension shows beside a source file. The tokenizing is the built-in SQL grammar's, reached across grammars by scope name, so generated SQL is coloured exactly as hand-written SQL is and this file has no patterns of its own to fall behind. What is different about the preview is not its tokens but its editor: it wraps by default, which is `configurationDefaults` in package.json, and it is why the preview gets a language of its own rather than `sql`.
